mechanical_compatibility_envelope.requirements: At most two new create attempts. Distinct diagnosis and exact sealed corrective diff required before optional last attempt. Use new isolated overlay and fresh run; no unchanged retry. Account every attempt in aggregate remaining original staging/create wall allowances; timeout=floor(remaining).
mechanical_compatibility_envelope.allowed_after_pre_generation_failure: Only executable/script/cwd absolute-path correction or Tcl invocation parsing correction that preserves all property values, source selection, output path expectations and checker semantics. Full canonical diff/recorded evidence must establish this mechanically before launch. No new permission needed for those exact corrections within remaining budget.
mechanical_compatibility_envelope.stop_for_review: Any config/JSON whitelist change, output containment or expected-path relaxation, locked IP not explained solely by permitted invocation typo, source/hash/library/generated-product drift, any error after first generate_target, resource guard stop, or protocol/numerical change. Stage3/4 failure has no retry under this gate.
